set.name: Human lung (Xenium Human Lung panel)
set.about: The lung's main cell types from well-established markers, every one in the Xenium Human Lung Gene Expression panel (hLung_v1.1), chosen to be specific in this panel's development data set (where tumor cells express COL5A2 and PROX1). The panel has no pan-immune marker (PTPRC), so the immune class is scored by leading markers of each immune lineage. A starting point, to be checked against each cluster's markers and edited: tumor cells are labeled by the lineage they resemble.

references.citation: Travaglini KJ, et al. A molecular cell atlas of the human lung from single-cell RNA sequencing. Nature 2020;587:619–625.
